LanguageData.DMSE.Landfill.FillDesc: Mark this entrance to be filled in, then right-click it with a colonist to start.\n\nFilling destroys the sealed room. Anyone and anything still inside is lost. The filled entrance can be deconstructed or reopened as a new, empty room.
LanguageData.DMSE.Landfill.ReopenDesc: Mark this filled entrance to be dug out again, then right-click it with a colonist to start. The room behind it will be new and empty.
